svg.title: Parseff: direct-style parser combinators for OCaml 5
svg.desc: A launch film for Parseff. The wordmark springs in; Angstrom's monadic binds light up red, then dissolve as each bound name slides to the front of its line as plain let-in code, and the card shrinks into the next shot; a cursor parses an IP address while the octet parser's lines light up, and 256 fails with a typed error; a broken statement list first stops at one error, then with diagnostics parses through with holes and two reported errors; two chunks split mid-token feed a push parser; JSON benchmark bars grow; six feature tiles cascade in; the end card shows opam install parseff.
